t: What Power Quality Database Is All About
title: What Power Quality Database Is All About
description: Power quality is how clean the electricity is: sags (voltage dips from faults), swells, harmonics (distorted waveforms from electronics), transients (lightning spikes), and frequency drift. Semiconductor fabs lose millions per sag; hospitals can't tolerate them. CBEMA/ITIC curves define what equipment should ride through. Monitor at the sensitive load — the grid's average hides the local truth. This database is the complete power quality event: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Power Quality Database: a complete reference database of full power quality event records.
key_points: What this database holds: full power quality event records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
